notes: TRACKR is extra aware of re-covered loads: it spots a re-cover from more signals (status back to Unassigned/Tendered, location cleared, driver phone, driver name or MC/DOT change, or a carrier swap it notices between refreshes) and restarts the trail; with two trucks it follows the one making progress toward delivery; it warns when pings since a re-cover still come from where the previous truck was; and the load details note the re-cover in plain words.
